title: ReplicatesContentCommitment
description: Payload shape for a Mishpat::Commitment entry with action='replicates-content' (migration-window alias: 'replicates-commons'). The EPR content-provide commitment: a peer commits to replicate an EPR at a declared reach (content variant) or to offer hosting capacity to the commons (capacity variant). The content variant generalizes past commons: reach is read through from the content, with reach_ceiling >= reach (well-ordering); non-commons reach carries a downstream consent burden (the provide reconciler's eligibility gate). The capacity variant stays commons-ratio-attested. Source of truth: Holochain DHT (Mishpat zome, existing Commitment entry type — action discriminator distinguishes; no new entry type). oneOf union on `variant`. NOTE: the author does NOT supply `epr_scope`; the effective bounds.epr_scope is derived as [head_ref] at projection time. Reach widening: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-13-non-commons-provide-commitments-design.md; original loop: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-08-epr-acquisition-slice2b-provide-loop-design.md §4.

action.description: Action discriminator. 'replicates-content' is the reach-general content-provide action; 'replicates-commons' is the migration-window alias both validators honor for one window.

variant.description: Union discriminator. 'content' = pure provide of a specific EPR (head_ref) at a declared reach; 'capacity' = hosting-capacity offer to the commons (commons_bytes + ratio_attestation).

reach_ceiling.description: Upper reach bound (>= the content's reach). The 8 DNA-notarized reach values, inlined (not $ref'd) so the standalone Ajv strict mini-test compiles without addSchema. The capacity variant pins this to commons by convention (commons-ratio-attested).

oneOf.title: ContentVariant
oneOf.description: Pure provide of one EPR at a declared reach. The author supplies only rate_per_minute + reach_ceiling in bounds; the effective epr_scope is derived as [head_ref] at projection time (not author-supplied). `reach` is the content's own reach (any of the 8 DNA-notarized values) and must satisfy reach_ceiling >= reach (enforced structurally by the validator, not the schema). The policy envelope fields provider/valid_from/valid_until are required: the storage projection reads them fail-closed and bounds_validator check 3 needs the validity window.

reach.description: The content's declared reach. Any of the 8 DNA-notarized schema-8 values, inlined (not $ref'd) for standalone Ajv strict compilation. The well-ordering reach_ceiling >= reach is a structural validator check (ordinal), not expressible in JSON Schema here. NOTE: this wire contract mirrors the DECIDED Stage-B DNA validator (reach ∈ schema-8); the STORAGE PROJECTION layer is deliberately MORE PERMISSIVE (spec §6 read-through — it projects whatever content::reach holds, including drifted production values like local/household/neighborhood). Do not 'reconcile' the two by re-tightening the projection parser — that re-drops those rows.
